caption: The drawing depicts a street scene set in front of a large building with two tall towers in the background at the center, framed by rows of multi-story buildings on both sides. In the foreground, there are two distinct groups of people. On the right, a formation of soldiers dressed in red uniforms, black hats, and white trousers is shown in a line, firing their muskets in unison toward a crowd. Gray smoke is emerging from the muskets at the center of the composition, obscuring part of the street scene. On the left, a group of civilians, some of whom are falling or lying on the ground with blue and other colored clothing, appear to be struck by the gunfire; several are depicted with expressions of alarm or distress, and there are visible red marks and pools near a few individuals that suggest wounds. Behind the civilians, more people are gathered, some gesturing or raising their arms. In the mid-ground, a small black and brown dog is depicted near the feet of the fallen figures. The sky is blue with some cloud-like formations. The color palette consists primarily of blue, red, black, gray, brown, and white. There is also printed text above and below the scene, including a title at the top and several lines of text at the bottom that provide further context or information related to the event depicted. The drawing is bordered by a plain margin.
title: Paul Revere Print
